Ivy S: Hi team! Im Ivy, just started today on Product Analytics. Hybrid in Toronto (North York). I bike to the office sometimes and bake sourdough on weekends. Super excited to meet folks! :wave:
Tom B: Welcome Ivy!! :tada: North York represent. What kind of starter do you keep?
Ivy S: I keep a 3-year rye starter that survived a house move and a power outage 62C. Will gladly bring mini loaves someday.
Rhea M: Yum. Also heads-up: parking near the office can be tight. If you ever need a spot, ping me 4CD I have a guest pass occasionally.
Lena Q: Welcome! Quick onboarding FYI: your Okta and Google groups are set. Swag form is in #people-ops pinned.
Ivy S: Thanks Lena! Any sticker recommendations for a baker-cyclist hybrid theme?
Noah P: :bike: + :bread: stickers please. Also vote in this quick poll: reply with :coffee:, :tea:, or :matcha: 375 Which is your desk drink?
Tom B: :coffee: dark roast 
Rhea M: :matcha: morning ritual
Lena Q: :tea: green for me
SwagBot: Ivy S, swag request received: hoodie (M), enamel pin (bread) queued. Delivery ETA: 7-10 business days.
Ivy S: This is amazing, thanks everyone. Also curious about the monthly game night 3AE is that still happening remotely?
Tom B: Yep, still monthly. Usually Friday evenings PT. We rotate board games and quick coding puzzles.
Rhea M: Welcome again Ivy, excited to have another baker. Will DM you my sourdough checklist.
Ivy S: Appreciate it all 604 Looking forward to the intro lunch and to stealing sticker ideas.
